title: Newton's second law of motion (নিউটনের দ্বিতীয় গতি সূত্র)
placement: Book pages 75–76, topic 3.6: বস্তুর গতির উপর বলের প্রভাব: নিউটনের দ্বিতীয় গতি সূত্র. Next to the football and cricket-ball examples, the law in its box and the steps to F = ma.
description: Vivid live 3D Newton second-law lesson for textbook topic 3.6, pages 75–76. A child rides a coral wagon pushed by an adult or two children across the polished floor of a rice godown; wheels turn, pushers walk and cargo changes the total mass. A live 3D free-body diagram shows individual pushes, friction, ground support and weight. Students can compare a smooth floor with a constant 20 N resisting force. By default the run plays at half speed (the clock on the view says so): the force and acceleration arrows grow in before the cart moves, a clock shows t, and at each whole second of the push the run holds while the velocity is stamped on the floor, so the equal steps of v (0 → 1 → 2 m/s) show the acceleration; a button switches to real time. Beside F = ma a live velocity–time graph draws the push with a step of +a each second, keeping the lines of the examples tried so their steepness compares (double force: twice as steep; double mass: half); bars give the force (one piece per person), the mass (one piece per sack) and a = F ÷ m, all from the same motion state; a separate calculation sheet connects them to the textbook momentum derivation at constant mass in SI units. Cart 80 kg + passenger 20 kg form the 100 kg unloaded system; cargo adds 50 kg per sack. Four examples and five scene-based tap questions are retained. Offline, Bangla/English, with GLB export.
